examples: Google Gemini news this week October 2026
open-source AI model released this week Hugging Face October 2026
Meta Muse Spark Open open-weight model release
JAXA MMX Phobos sample return launch H3 October 19
James Webb telescope new finding October 2026
Venus day longer than its year NASA
Saturn density less than water would float NASA

Waymo robotaxis headed to Canada Toronto October 16 2026
Muse Spark Open two Mac Studio M5 Ultra MLX Hugging Face 42 billion active

category_rule: last 10 published: 7 ai_tech, 3 science -> neither forced rule triggered; best topic overall.
style_rule: last two styles were cosmic (10-15) and newsflash (10-16); both avoided. countdown was used for Meta's Muse Wonder on 10-13, so mythfact is used for variety and fits the 'giant AI needs a data center' misconception.
novelty_note: Muse Wonder (10-13) was Meta's closed, paid model. Muse Spark Open is a separate release (open weights, Apple partnership, local hardware), so it is not a repeat; novelty scored down to 6 anyway.
verification_note: WebFetch cannot resolve news hosts from the sandbox; facts confirmed from search-result text of >=2 independent outlets plus Meta's developer blog. Hardware memory figures (700 GB vs 1 TB) conflict between outlets, so they are left out of the script.

selected.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model optimized for two Mac Studios (with Apple)
selected.summary: 816B total/42B active MoE, 1M-token context, multimodal input; on Hugging Face under Muse Model License; needs >=700GB GPU memory (NVFP4), ~1.6TB BF16 weights

runner_up.title: Waymo picks Toronto as first Canadian robotaxi city
runner_up.summary: Waymo approved for Ontario AV pilot; will map Toronto with manually driven cars, targets riders in 2028.

verified_facts: 816B total parameters, mixture-of-experts with ~42B active per token (Meta dev blog, 9to5Mac, Dataconomy).
Context window up to 1 million tokens (Meta dev blog, Dataconomy).
Optimized to run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios with MLX; Apple and Meta worked together (Meta on X, CNBC, 9to5Mac).
Weights downloadable on Hugging Face (TechCrunch, Meta dev blog).
Muse Model License: free for many developers with limits on commercial use (Meta dev blog, TechCrunch).

candidates.title: Japan's MMX Phobos sample-return mission launches Oct 19
candidates.summary: JAXA's MMX launches on H3 from Tanegashima Oct 19 19:41 UTC (Oct 20 JST); to land on Mars moon Phobos in 2030, return >=10 g of soil in 2031; ESA/NASA/CNES/DLR partners.

candidates.title: SpaceX CRS-35 Dragon docks with ISS carrying final new solar arrays
candidates.summary: Cargo Dragon docked to Harmony Oct 15 at 10:27 a.m. EDT with ~6,300 lb of cargo incl. final pair of Roll-Out Solar Arrays; launched Oct 13.

candidates.title: CoreWeave plunges ~12% as AI-debt worries hit tech
candidates.summary: CoreWeave fell ~11-13% on Oct 16, heading for ~25% weekly loss; Nebius -10%, Nasdaq ~-2%.

candidates.title: Gmail Live: talk to your inbox rolls out
candidates.summary: Gemini-powered voice Q&A over email rolling out to Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra and Workspace mobile from Oct 15, answers cite source emails.

candidates.title: A teaspoon of neutron star weighs ~a billion tons
candidates.summary: Neutron stars pack more than the Sun's mass into a ~20 km sphere; a teaspoon of material would weigh around a billion tons on Earth.

candidates.title: Sharks are older than trees
candidates.summary: Undisputed shark scales date to ~420 million years ago; the first true tree, Archaeopteris, appears ~385 million years ago.

candidates.title: Wombats poop cubes
candidates.summary: Uneven stretchiness in the last part of the wombat intestine shapes droppings into cubes (Georgia Tech, Soft Matter 2021); the only animal known to do so.

candidates.title: Saturn would float in water
candidates.summary: Saturn's average density is ~0.687 g/cm3, less than water's ~1 g/cm3; the only planet less dense than water.

candidates.title: Tardigrades survived naked in space
candidates.summary: On ESA's FOTON-M3 (2007, Current Biology 2008) water bears survived 10 days of open-space vacuum; some even survived vacuum plus solar UV.

candidates.title: Mantis shrimp punch boils water
candidates.summary: Its club strikes at ~23 m/s with bullet-like acceleration, creating cavitation bubbles whose collapse adds a second hit (Patek, Nature 2004).

candidates.title: It rains diamonds on Neptune and Uranus
candidates.summary: SLAC's X-ray laser squeezed plastic to ~5,000 K and 150 GPa, turning nearly all its carbon into nanodiamonds, supporting diamond rain inside ice giants (Nature Astronomy 2017).

candidates.title: ISRO completes Gaganyaan crew-service module separation tests
candidates.summary: Pyrotechnic CM-SM separation tests at VSSC Thiruvananthapuram validated; uncrewed G1 still targeted for 2026, no date.

candidates.title: Microsoft finishes pre-training MAI-Base-2, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model
candidates.summary: 2.8T total/80B active MoE; trained on 16,000 GB200 GPUs for 38 days on 50T tokens (18% image data); claims 4-12x more FLOPs-efficient than DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base; still in post-training

candidates.title: Reflection AI open-sources Beam weights
candidates.summary: Beam: 501B-param sparse MoE (23B active), trained on 23.8T tokens, Apache 2.0; claims GLM-5.2-level reasoning with 3-4x less inference compute; announced Oct 5, weights posted Oct 16

candidates.title: BYD's 'Xiao Di' humanoid robot heads to showrooms
candidates.summary: Reported 1.61m, 58.5kg, 31 degrees of freedom (unconfirmed by BYD); to greet customers at Di Space centers; design patent published Oct 9

candidates.title: Jensen Huang urges US-China dialogue on 'potentially dangerous' AI
candidates.summary: At a London briefing Oct 15, Nvidia CEO said AI is potentially dangerous and Nvidia should work with Chinese AI firms to monitor risks.

candidates.title: Venture Global orders gas power islands for 10 GW of AI data centers
candidates.summary: Frame deals with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes for up to 16 x 720 MW power islands; path to up to 10 GW compute by 2034.

candidates.title: BeyondTrust zero-day exploited by China-linked group since August
candidates.summary: CVE-2026-102764 (CVSS 9.3) in Remote Support exploited from Aug 29 by UNC5221, which wiped logs; fix shipped.

candidates.title: Apple unveils HomeView display and new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI
candidates.summary: Oct 13 event: 7-inch HomeView smart display, Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini 2 built around new Siri AI

candidates.title: TSMC Q3 2026 record revenue $46.7B
candidates.summary: TSMC Q3 revenue US$46.72B (+41.2% YoY), net income NT$763.06B (+68.7%), 2nm = 8% of wafer revenue; Q4 guide $52.3-54.3B.

candidates.title: ASML record EUR 11.7B quarter, says 2027-28 supply can't meet demand
candidates.summary: ASML Q3 net sales record EUR11.7B, 57.5% gross margin, Q4 guide EUR14.2-15.2B; says planned 2027-2028 supply will not fully meet customer demand.

candidates.title: 'Pac-Man' enzyme eats bioplastics AND penicillin
candidates.summary: Univ. of Konstanz biologists found a bacterial enzyme with a wide-open active site that breaks down polyester bioplastics and also cleaves penicillin (ISME Journal); biodegradable plastics fully broke down in soil within ~1 year.

candidates.title: Century-old drawer fossil is a new giant-clawed dinosaur
candidates.summary: Invictibellatrix amberina, a 120-million-year-old megaraptoran (3-4 m long) identified from a skull fragment the Natural History Museum acquired in 1924; first megaraptoran known from Europe (Royal Society Open Science).

candidates.title: Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark N1X goes on sale
candidates.summary: Microsoft's first Nvidia Arm laptop, from $2,599, available Oct 16; reviews: runs 35B-param model locally, GPU ~RTX 5070-class.

candidates.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11; Disney bids $20M
candidates.summary: Filed Oct 12 in Delaware; Disney stalking-horse bid $20M for non-exclusive perpetual IP license; bids due Nov 20, auction Nov 23; platform keeps running

candidates.title: Google replaces Gemini Gems with 'Skills'
candidates.summary: Skills hit Gemini app Oct 13 (Workspace Oct 5); Gem creation stopped Oct 13; personal Gems auto-migrate Nov 17; built on open SKILL.md format

candidates.title: Tech Mahindra Q2 profit +32.7%, 1:1 bonus; stock +7.5%
candidates.summary: Net profit Rs1,586 cr (+32.7% YoY), revenue Rs16,180 cr; deal wins $1.023B; shares +7.46% on Oct 16.

candidates.title: Microsoft patches record 1,413 vulnerabilities
candidates.summary: October Patch Tuesday fixed record 1,413 CVEs incl. one exploited Mark-of-the-Web bypass zero-day; CISA deadline Oct 16.

candidates.title: Apple HomePod mini 2: S10 chip, Sound Glow, $149
candidates.summary: Announced Oct 13; S10 chip, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 6, light-up Sound Glow top; ships Oct 30; Siri AI later.

candidates.title: Artemis III boosters stacked; NASA briefing set Oct 23
candidates.summary: NASA completed Artemis III booster stacking; Isaacman to brief on Artemis III/IV on Oct 23.

candidates.title: Black holes of every size launch jets by the same rule
candidates.summary: Nature Astronomy study (Mummery/IAS, Goodwin/Curtin) of 10 tidal disruption events: supermassive black holes fire jets when feeding drops to ~2% of the Eddington limit, the same threshold seen in 10-solar-mass black holes.

candidates.title: World's first self-stabilizing nuclear clock
candidates.summary: TU Wien and PTB built a thorium-229 nuclear clock that ran 24+ hours unattended, locking its own laser to the nucleus; precision ~1e-15 over a day (about 1 s in 30 million years).

candidates.title: A day on Venus is longer than its year
candidates.summary: Venus rotates once every 243.02 Earth days but orbits the Sun in 225 days (Margot et al., Nature Astronomy); it also spins backwards.

candidates.title: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood
candidates.summary: Two hearts pump blood through the gills, one to the body; copper-based hemocyanin makes blood blue.

candidates.title: Honey from Egyptian tombs stayed preserved for millennia
candidates.summary: Low water activity (~0.5-0.6), acidity (pH 3.4-4.5) and bee-made hydrogen peroxide stop microbes; pots of ancient honey have been found preserved (tasting stories are poorly documented).

candidates.title: Eiffel Tower grows in summer
candidates.summary: Thermal expansion of its iron makes the 300 m tower up to ~12-15 cm taller in heat, and it leans slightly away from the Sun (some calcs say ~5 cm).

candidates.title: Bananas are slightly radioactive
candidates.summary: About 1 in 8,500 potassium atoms is radioactive K-40 (half-life ~1.25 billion years); a banana gives ~0.1 microsievert, harmless.

candidates.title: Sunlight you see is 8 minutes 20 seconds old
candidates.summary: At ~150 million km, light takes ~500 s to arrive, ranging 490-507 s over Earth's elliptical orbit.

candidates.title: RapidCanvas raises $29M Series B
candidates.summary: Led by Vertex Ventures SEA & India with Hitachi Ventures; total $52.5M; ARR up 8x in six quarters

candidates.title: Google DeepMind launches AI workbench to hunt new antibiotics
candidates.summary: Antigravity AMP workbench combines ProtNLM + AlphaFold to find antimicrobial peptides; agent surfaced a 97-amino-acid bacteriocin candidate now heading to wet-lab tests; AMR projected 10M deaths/yr by 2050

candidates.title: MIT/Whitehead AI model IRIS decodes the language cells use to communicate
candidates.summary: IRIS uses transfer learning to read signaling 'fingerprints' across cell types; trained on human stem cells, predicted mouse embryo signaling incl. a lung pathway confirmed in experiments; Nature Methods

candidates.title: Blue Origin New Glenn return slips to early 2027
candidates.summary: Reuters (Oct 16): return to flight now expected early 2027 after May ground-test explosion damaged its only pad.

candidates.title: ESA signs MoU with Vast on post-ISS cooperation
candidates.summary: ESA and Vast sign MoU for LEO cooperation as ESA studies European-led station.

candidates.title: Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds colliding
candidates.summary: 21 extreme debris disks studied; dust implies Mars-sized impacts like the Moon-forming one.

candidates.title: Homo erectus in South Africa 2 million years ago
candidates.summary: Adult skull fragment DNH 127 from Drimolen dated 2.04-1.95 Myr, ~200,000 years earlier than thought; Paranthropus fossils outnumber H. erectus there 10 to 1.

candidates.title: Quantum computer recreates 'ghost' magnetic effect
candidates.summary: Oxford physicists used a hybrid quantum computer to simulate a particle responding to a magnetic field it never passes through (Aharonov-Bohm-type effect).

candidates.title: Tecno Spark 50s 5G launches in India
candidates.summary: Budget 5G phone unveiled Oct 16 in India; official price not confirmed in sources.

candidates.title: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.163.0

candidates.title: Earth's water may have been 'cooked' from dry pebbles

candidates.title: Webb finds galaxy cluster that grew up too fast

candidates.title: Webb sees signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
candidates.summary: Webb studied 21 extreme debris disks around young stars to gauge planet-scale collisions like the one that made our Moon (ApJ, Oct 1).

candidates.title: Oldest semiaquatic 'platypus-like' mammal relative
candidates.summary: Early Cretaceous fossil from China, ~40 cm long and 190 g, is the oldest known semiaquatic mammal-like animal (Nature Communications).

candidates.title: Uranium ditelluride shows pair-density-wave superconductivity
